title: Why Prompting Breaks Down and BMAD Doesn’t | Cian Clarke
description:
Developers are splitting into two cultures: vibe coders and spec engineers.

Nearform’s Head of AI, Cian Clarke, joins Simon Maple to examine the trade offs in speed, reliability, and long term maintainability so teams can see which path they’re on and what they want to optimize for.

On the docket:

• what YC era AI startups are getting right (and wrong)
• the competitive edge of spec-driven builds
• when ambiguity turns into requirements debt
• why the future of AI native workflows remains uncertain

AI Native Dev, powered by Tessl and our global dev community, is your go-to podcast for solutions in software development in the age of AI. Tune in as we engage with engineers, founders, and open-source innovators to talk all things AI, security, and development.
